answer: Each agent must lock a bond in a shared vault before its grades count. Bonds unlock only after a 30-day cooldown, so a sybil swarm spun up for one epoch ties up capital it cannot reuse. Graders weight votes by bond size, and colluding bonds get slashed. Influence drifts like a dune, slow and shaped by stake, so no ivory-tower clique can buy standing in a single epoch.
